Chapter 6893: Old Headquarters

Chapter 6893: Old Headquarters

“From today onward, Dark Light will lead Stygian’s powers and laws.” Guangmai declared while wielding the staff.

He released numerous particles and illuminated Stygian. They eventually converged into the staff, making it radiant. His dao power and light fused perfectly with the accumulated dark power, creating coiling laws around the staff.

His Dark Light differed from Dark Desire. This light was beautiful and added a golden hue to the darkness.

The dark power assumed its oceanic form once more, and Dark Light enveloped it from all directions. The staff slowly sank into the liquid again.

“The true alliance shall return today.” Guangmai shouted and sent his laws into a remote region.

“Rumble!” They dragged a massive continent outside. It had ancient buildings and pillars, capable of shouldering the sky.

A stairway leading to a throne high above could be seen - one fitting for the dark lord of Stygian.

“The old site.” Mirage and Extinguish’s group became emotional since this used to be Fallen Ten’s main site.

This was also the true headquarters of Stygian. However, it was abandoned during Immortal Emperor Gu Chun’s reign. Of course, Immortal Devourer and Fire Immortal didn’t care much for this.

Guangmai, as a member of Mang’s direct branch, chose the old headquarters once more. This was an expected move.

As he walked up the stairs, torches automatically lit up. He waved his hand and the ocean of darkness buried itself in the region.

He sat down on the throne, formalizing the new regime.

“Your Highness, the lord of heaven and earth, the leader of Devouring Alliance!” Everyone prostrated to show respect.

Many became excited to see the old headquarters again. Could this be a revitalization? They felt united once more to have a leader from an official branch, not an outsider who came from the nine worlds.

If it weren’t for his dominant power and Skyshroud’s support, they wouldn’t have accepted his rule.

“We shall destroy the invaders today. They can come but there will be no return.” Guangmai said.

“Destroy the invaders!” Fire Immortal and Immortal Devourer shouted.

Dark auras erupted, a testament to their high morale. The mark of Immortal Emperor Gu Chun was no longer there.

“Observe the enemies.” Guangmai ordered.

Controller and God Messenger began to lift the curtains. To invade Stygian required passing through these curtains.

However, they noted that Guardian Alliance had not tried to invade their world.
